allow: Bash(node -e "const { Pool } = require\('@neondatabase/serverless'\); const fs = require\('fs'\); async function run\(\) { const pool = new Pool\({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }\); const sql = fs.readFileSync\('../Database/development.sql', 'utf8'\); const statements = sql.split\(';'\).filter\(s => s.trim\(\).length > 0\); for \(const s of statements\) { if \(!s.trim\(\).toUpperCase\(\).startsWith\('COPY'\)\) { try { await pool.query\(s\); } catch \(e\) { console.error\('Error: ' + e.message\); } } } await pool.end\(\); console.log\('Done'\); } run\(\);")
